lines.1: 「All right, time to go make dinner for my twelve little sisters.」
lines.3: 「That's the famous Ice Lawyer!? She has a different kind of dignified presence from Iron-senpai or the Princess. Seeing her in person, she has a charm you don't get through a TV screen.」
lines.5: 「Ugh. She's not exactly easy to approach. What an inconvenient personality I have.」
lines.38: 「Tell one of the students to bring Kiriya Erika here.」
lines.40: 「A successor candidate for the Company who can't be contacted immediately. How impressive.」
lines.42: 「If I had money, first thing I'd do is buy every fish sausage in the convenience store.」
lines.44: 「I'm such a devoted Iruka, if I do say so myself... Loyalty MAX.」
lines.47: 「Princess, he says some lawyer named Hiiragi is waiting at the school gate.」
lines.48: 「Huh? She should have my cell number.」
lines.50: 「Kiriya-san, have you finally committed a crime...?」
lines.52: Otome yanked hard on her ponytail.
lines.53: 「Ow, ow! No! Hiiragi Kaname is the lawyer who became counsel for the company!」
lines.55: 「Do I really look like I'd commit a crime?」
lines.58: 「Even if I did, I wouldn't be sloppy enough to let it come to light.」
lines.59: 「Statements like that are exactly the problem.」
